home.title: We build the systems a business runs on, keep them running, and test them before anyone else does.
home.lead: CyBarq is a Jordanian technology company. One team builds your platforms and internal systems, runs the infrastructure under them, and tests both the way an attacker would. We use AI where it genuinely helps, and leave it out where it does not.
home.indexIntro: Everything we do, on one page: four practices, 33 services. Narrow the list by practice, or type what you are looking for.

index.empty: Nothing matches that word. Try another one, or write to us and describe the problem in your own words.

home.statementBody: Done properly means the unglamorous parts are done too: the scope agreed in writing before anyone touches anything, the permission enforced in the database and not only on the screen, and a handover that leaves you able to work without us.
home.approachIntro: Four things we hold to in every engagement, whether it runs for two weeks or two years.
home.ctaTitle: Tell us what you are working on.
home.ctaBody: A few sentences is enough. We reply with questions rather than a proposal, and we say plainly if this is not work we should take. Remote, on site, or both: we work the way the project calls for.
home.seoTitle: CyBarq Technology LLC. Technology, done properly.
home.seoDescription: CyBarq is a Jordanian technology company. Software, infrastructure, cybersecurity and AI from one team, working remotely and on site.
